# DeleteDir <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
DeleteDir:Void dir:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | In | String | required | The folder to delete. |

## Description

Deletes a folder. The folder has to be empty.
